traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Kirkiaceae: leaves alternate; leaves compound; compound leaves pinnate; stipules absent; plants monoecious or polygamous; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in cymes; perianth sepals and petals; fruit schizocarp; parts of each whorl 4; stamens 4; carpels 4. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
